start: Owner signed in, gym online with the member app on; Settings

steps.action: Tap the 'Member app' tab
user_sees: Subtitle 'What your members see in the MettleUp app'

Cards in order: 'Member app' with the gym's app code, the join free-trial card, 'Your look in the app', 'Challenges', the busy machines card, the bring-a-friend card, 'Free MettleUp Plus for your members'
'Members see your logo when the app opens, and your colour on every screen.'
'Give members a goal for the month. Everyone who reaches it wins free days. A top 10 list shows in the app.'
must_not: A card for a part the gym's server does not have yet
The app code of another gym

steps.action: Tap 'Open branding', come back, tap 'Open challenges'
user_sees: The branding page, then the Challenges page
must_not: Back lands on the Gym tab instead of Member app

start: Owner opens the tab by its own address

steps.action: Type the address of the Member app tab
user_sees: The Member app tab is the chosen one
must_not: The Gym tab shown under a Member app address

steps.action: Type a Settings address with an unknown last part
user_sees: The Gym tab
must_not: A blank page
An error

start: Owner of a gym that is not online, or with the member app off

steps.action: Open the Member app tab
user_sees: 'First turn on the member app above. Then you can add your logo and colour.' with 'Open branding' greyed
'First put your gym online in Settings → Sign-in & data. Then you can start a challenge for members.' with 'Open challenges' greyed
No busy machines, bring-a-friend or MettleUp Plus card
must_not: A greyed button with no word why
A card that opens a page that cannot save

steps.action: Tap 'Open branding' with the internet off on an online gym
user_sees: The button waits for the internet and says so
must_not: A branding page that loses the logo on save

start: Owner; a new part was added to this tab

steps.action: Open Settings before visiting the tab
user_sees: A 'new' dot on the 'Member app' tab
must_not: A dot with nothing new behind it

steps.action: Open the tab and the new part, then come back
user_sees: The dot is gone
must_not: The dot stays for ever
The dot gone on this device but unknown on another

steps.action: Go Gym → Member app → Sign-in & data, then press the browser's back button twice
user_sees: Member app, then Gym
must_not: Back leaves Settings in one step
